crossRefs.note: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he…
They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul…
Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen?…
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and…
bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you…
and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

translations.web: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
translations.bsb: Then Joseph sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving, he said to them, “Do not quarrel on the way!”
translations.kjv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
translations.asv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
